text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position against driverless cars from the start","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a focused claim early and keeps the argument centered on that position throughout."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on computer crashes and sleepy drivers","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It gives multiple argumentative reasons tied to possible safety problems rather than relying mainly on personal preference."},{"evidence":"\"As quoted from the article\" and the boredom quote","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It directly brings in the article to support its claim, showing connection to the assigned text."},{"evidence":"counterpoint about sensors and cameras","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"It acknowledges a possible benefit while still explaining why that benefit does not fully solve the problem."},{"evidence":"organized body paragraphs and concluding restatement","quality":"organization","description":"It is more clearly structured with an introduction, developed body, and conclusion that reinforce the same argument."}]}
